words.gloss: those whose nature is only laughter and amusement

literal: Than the friendship of those who are of the nature of laughter only, from enemies ten multiplied by crore benefits will accrue.
translation: Rather than the friendship of those who only make merry with you, ten million times more benefit will come from open enemies.
modern: சிரித்துப் பேசிப் பொழுதுபோக்கும் தன்மையுடையவரின் நட்பை விட, பகைவர்களால் பத்து கோடி மடங்கு நன்மைகள் உண்டாகும்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts superficial friends with open enemies. The term 'nakai-vakaiyar' refers to people whose association is limited to laughter, jokes, and superficial pleasantries, offering no genuine support in times of adversity. The poet declares that even the hostility of declared enemies is ten crore times more beneficial than such empty friendship. An open enemy allows one to be cautious and prepared, whereas a superficial friend gives a false sense of security and fails when help is most needed.
